Philip and the Ethiopian, Acts 8. A seeker in a chariot was reading and asking, and Philip, beginning that scripture, preached unto him Jesus, and they found water, and the man was baptized, rejoicing, going on his way. The Spirit sends His servants at the right time, and a searching heart and an open book can change a day. If you are asking questions, keep reading the Bible, ask God to make Jesus plain. He loves honest seekers.
